skill.summary: Generate a detailed, AI-powered audit report evaluating a prospect’s website, SEO, ads, social media, reputation, tech stack, and competitors to close deals...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate detailed AI-powered prospect audit reports from any website domain in minutes.

- Instantly audits website, SEO, ads, social media, reviews, tech stack, and competitors.
- Integrates with Apify Actors for comprehensive data collection.
- Generates structured, professional reports (JSON/Markdown) with scores, actionable insights, and personalized agency pitches.
- Provides top 5 critical issues and top 5 quick wins based on estimated revenue impact.
- Designed to help agencies close clients faster by sending pre-call audits.
